calls.title: Ashley / Matthew - outbound
calls.summary: The team is establishing a structured process to enhance lead management and boost sales efficiency. Matthew Du Pont aims to create a BDR playbook that automates lead prioritization and reduces manual effort, which is supported by Ashley Stirrup's efforts to integrate lead flows into HubSpot. The discussion also covered the early-stage Rio data integration, which has potential for improving lead scoring and marketing-sales workflows. Matthew assessed Growth Book's competitive positioning, noting its strengths in experimentation compared to competitors like LaunchDarkly. Additionally, Ashley is running multiple lead generation programs and targeting AI-driven companies to emphasize the importance of experimentation in product development. Internal coordination efforts are being made to improve communication between marketing and sales teams.
calls.keywords: Lead Generation, BDR Playbook, Feature Flags, Experimentation, Rio Platform, Marketing Events
